newsitem.title: CHINA: Peregrine unit opens office in East Java.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine unit opens office in East Java.

text.p: Peregrine Investment Holdings Ltd said on Monday that its Indonesian unit P.T. Peregrine Sewu Securities has opened a sales office in East Java's Surabaya city.
The new office is Peregrine Sewu's first outside its home base of Jakarta and will serve a growing client base in the East Java region, Peregrine said in a statement.
The new office has a staff of 10 and will specialize in the distribution of equity products, it said.
The office will concentrate on the high net worth individual and corporate segments of the investor spectrum, Peregrine said.
